title: Clay Doll In Java (Player Renderer)
description: It renders the player in the top right of the screen just like in bedrock.
body:
A small 3D player (clay doll) is rendered in the top left corner of the screen, giving you a quick visual of your character at all times.

The doll mirrors your player in real time just like in Bedrock. it even mirrors your armor and weapons and also animations.
